T2_hero.h1: Bio-Rad controls for infectious disease testing
T2_hero.lead: Control materials for checking the performance of serological and molecular infectious disease testing methods.

T3_about.h2: What Bio-Rad infectious disease controls are
T3_about.text: Infectious Disease Controls are Bio-Rad control materials for serological and molecular infectious disease testing. The range includes positive and negative controls for checking the performance of testing methods. It covers viral and other infectious targets, while the specific composition depends on the product.

items.text: The materials let laboratories monitor applicable testing procedures independently of the test kit. Positive and negative options support checks of testing method performance.

T6_items.summary: Amplichek II, VIROTROL, and VIROCLEAR controls
T6_items.footnote: Catalog numbers are from the official Bio-Rad catalog. Pack sizes were not collected; ask a LabWell manager about the range supplied in Ukraine.

T10_faq.h2: Infectious disease controls: questions and answers

items.q: What are Infectious Disease Controls used for?
items.a: They are used to check the performance of serological and molecular infectious disease testing methods.
The range includes positive and negative controls. Specific composition depends on the product.

items.q: Which targets does the range cover?
items.a: The range covers viral and other infectious targets.

items.q: Who supplies Bio-Rad controls in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is a Bio-Rad partner and supplier in Ukraine.
